scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained for every finite size. Exact exhaustive computations corroborate finitely many cases; they are not substituted for the all-size proof. Independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: All theorems concern finite, nontrivial Heyting algebras and uniformly sampled ordered pairs. No general fixed-join-irreducible extremum, higher-defect spectrum, or infinite-algebra extension is claimed. Priority beyond inspected accessible sources is uncertain.
title: Sharp first-defect rigidity for the second De Morgan law in finite Heyting algebras
